description: This file defines the AWS TextractClient class, which extends AWS's general AwsClient class. It provides method annotations for interacting with the Amazon Textract service, including various analysis and detection operations, as well as adapter management functionalities.

classes.name: Aws	extract	extractClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Textract service via AWS SDK for PHP. It provides various methods for document analysis, text detection, and managing resource adapters.

methods.name: analyzeDocument
methods.description: Performs analysis of a document to extract text and data.

methods.name: analyzeDocumentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes a document to extract text and data.

methods.name: detectDocumentTextAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously detects text in a document.

methods.name: getDocumentAnalysis
methods.description: Retrieves the results of a document analysis operation.

methods.name: startDocumentAnalysis
methods.description: Starts the analysis of a document.
